title: Are We Ready for Chinese Bikes? Winspace SLC 3.0 review vs Giant TCR...

takeaways.text: The size-L test bike Winspace supplied, with Ultegra Di2 and ~1,200 g carbon wheels, weighed 6.66 kg without pedals; Winspace claims under 700 g for an unpainted medium frame.

One-piece aero cockpit with round steerer and split spacers, a round 27.2 mm seatpost with external clamp, covered thru-axle ends (awkward on smart trainers) and a press-fit (PF86, per the reviewer) bottom bracket.
After about five weeks: rides as well as, though not better than, a Giant TCR Advanced Pro, climbs very well and is smooth on rough roads with 28 mm tires; less fast on flats than an aero bike.

The front-derailleur mount worked loose, unplugging its wire, which he attributes to assembly or missing threadlocker; he notes repairs may mean shipping to China where there is no local Winspace service, and a 3-year warranty versus Giant's lifetime cover.

disclosure: The description identifies Squarespace as an episode sponsor. Winspace frame-supply and payment terms are not established by that description.
summary: Review of a Winspace SLC 3.0 road build with ride, equipment and issue discussion. Creator chapter links help navigate the review; its build and comparisons do not establish checkout or warranty in mainland China.
